thesis: The page is the relay board: each section is a station on a timed course, and the running stopwatch total proves speed without promising what isn't true.

signature.name: Stopwatch Stations
signature.summary: A vertical stopwatch rail with lap pills per station and a cumulative total that updates on scroll; hero shows 00:00, service stations add laps, proof uses split-time cards, footer stops the clock.

motion.intro: Stacked lines drop in on 70ms stagger with rail pulse; photo strip slides in via clip-path wipe from right.
stories: Stopwatch hand sweeps as stations enter; lap pills stack with 60ms stagger; rail fills via --sw-p.
Sample report cards slide in as split-time printouts; done stamp presses in.
motion.hover: Hairline under station names grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms, hover:hover only.
